author.name: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University Library

description:
Your library and research companion for National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU) — access library services and academic resources without leaving ChatGPT.

Search the library catalog for books, journals, and dissertations across NYCU and the Taiwan United University System (UST). Check your personal dashboard — active loans, due dates, holds, and purchase requests — at a glance. Dive into academic research with Semantic Scholar integration: search papers, read abstracts, explore citations and references, and discover similar work.

Features:
- Library catalog search (physical and online, filter by campus and format)
- Personal library dashboard: loans, due dates, holds, purchase requests

Results appear in interactive widgets — book cards and a personal account view — making library research feel native to your conversation. 
Built for NYCU students, researchers, and staff.
